segments.text: Effective material safety isn't just about adequate prevention of risks due to proper
segments.zh: 有效的材料安全不只是通过妥善储存

segments.text: storage.
segments.zh: 来充分预防风险。

segments.text: You also have to prepare for any emergencies that might come your way.
segments.zh: 你还必须为可能遇到的任何紧急情况做好准备。

segments.text: There are specific areas of your workplace that you'll have to outfit for this kind
segments.zh: 你的工作场所中有一些特定区域，需要为这类

segments.text: of emergency response.
segments.zh: 应急响应配备相应设施。

segments.text: For example, OSHA requires the following.
segments.zh: 例如，OSHA 要求如下。

segments.text: Portable tanks to have provision for emergency venting.
segments.zh: 便携式罐应设有紧急泄压装置。

segments.text: Op-mounted emergency vents must be capable of limiting internal pressure, under fire exposure
segments.zh: 顶部安装的紧急泄压口必须能够在受火条件下，

segments.text: conditions to 10 psi gauge or 30% of the bursting pressure of the tank, whichever is greater.
segments.zh: 将内部压力限制在 10 psi 表压或罐体爆破压力的 30%，以两者中较大者为准。

segments.text: In essence, you'll have to outfit your work area to handle proper ventilation in the case
segments.zh: 从本质上说，你必须为工作区配备设施，以便在发生紧急情况时

segments.text: of emergencies.
segments.zh: 进行适当的通风。

segments.text: And remember that the specific risk factors of different materials can lead to different
segments.zh: 还要记住，不同材料的特定风险因素，可能会使你的工作场所产生不同的

segments.text: emergency needs in your workspace.
segments.zh: 应急需求。

segments.text: You're going to have to address those to ensure that you can handle the proper emergency
segments.zh: 你必须解决这些问题，以确保你能针对每种情况

segments.text: response for each situation.
segments.zh: 进行正确的应急响应。

segments.text: OSHA also outlines hazardous waste operations and emergency response, or HAZWAPR.
segments.zh: OSHA 还规定了危险废物作业与应急响应，也就是 HAZWOPER。

segments.text: They recommend you contact the OSHA regional office or area office near you to find out
segments.zh: 他们建议你联系离你最近的 OSHA 地区办公室或区域办公室，了解

segments.text: what training will be required to meet OSHA standards.
segments.zh: 需要哪些培训才能达到 OSHA 标准。

segments.text: They'll also guide you to finding the place for obtaining the training.
segments.zh: 他们还会指导你找到获取培训的地方。

segments.text: So what about receiving a specific OSHA training program?
segments.zh: 那么，接受某个特定的 OSHA 培训项目怎么样？

segments.text: OSHA does not certify any specific training programs, and OSHA does state that computer-based
segments.zh: OSHA 并不认证任何特定的培训项目，而且 OSHA 确实声明，基于计算机的

segments.text: training is not sufficient to meet its safety standards.
segments.zh: 培训不足以满足其安全标准。

segments.text: It can all be a little bit confusing, since OSHA doesn't say what training standards
segments.zh: 这一切可能有点让人困惑，因为 OSHA 没有说我们必须达到什么样的培训标准，

segments.text: we have to meet, but it does say what your training should exceed.
segments.zh: 但它确实说明了你的培训应该超出哪些内容。

segments.text: Fortunately, OSHA does outline some specific keys for employee training that are going to
segments.zh: 幸运的是，OSHA 确实列出了员工培训的一些具体要点，这些要点将

segments.text: help you improve the emergency response of everyone who deals with the hazardous materials
segments.zh: 帮助你提高每一个接触相关危险材料的人员的

segments.text: in question.
segments.zh: 应急响应能力。

segments.text: This includes the requirements for hands-on experience and the ability for people to ask
segments.zh: 这包括对实际操作经验的要求，以及如果有人对任何培训材料不熟悉，

segments.text: questions if any training material is unfamiliar to them.
segments.zh: 能够提出问题。

segments.text: Though not complete, this does specify what kinds of training guidelines you'll want
segments.zh: 虽然并不完整，但这确实明确了你需要建立

segments.text: to put in place.
segments.zh: 哪些类型的培训准则。

segments.text: For starters, hands-on experience is critical for any employee.
segments.zh: 首先，实际操作经验对任何员工都至关重要。

segments.text: This is about material handling, right?
segments.zh: 这是关于材料处理的，对吧？

segments.text: If there's an emergency lever to pull in case of fire, for example, it's not the kind of
segments.zh: 比如说，如果发生火灾时有一个紧急拉杆要拉，这可不是那种

segments.text: training you'll want to conduct on a computer, giving people a test.
segments.zh: 你会在计算机上进行、给大家做个测试就完事的培训。

segments.text: This also highlights why material-specific training is key.
segments.zh: 这也说明了为什么针对具体材料的培训很关键。

segments.text: Not every emergency situation is going to be the same.
segments.zh: 不是每种紧急情况都一样。

segments.text: Not every workspace is going to be the same.
segments.zh: 也不是每个工作场所都一样。

segments.text: Your employees need to know the proper procedures for your workspace, including alarms, proximity
segments.zh: 你的员工需要了解你们工作场所的正确程序，包括警报、安全设备

segments.text: of safety equipment, obtaining access to safety equipment, and communication procedures to
segments.zh: 的位置、如何取用安全设备，以及向整个工作场所

segments.text: alert the entire workspace.
segments.zh: 发出警报的沟通程序。

segments.text: That's the kind of training that only comes by seeing where to do, what to do, and maybe
segments.zh: 这种培训只有通过亲眼看到在哪里做、做什么，甚至

segments.text: even what the risks might look like in practice.
segments.zh: 看到这些风险在实际中可能是什么样子，才能获得。

segments.text: Okay, finally, let's look at some key areas of risk to avoid when you're talking about
segments.zh: 好，最后，我们来看看在谈到工作场所危害时

segments.text: hazards in the workplace.
segments.zh: 需要避免的一些关键风险领域。

segments.text: Addressing these issues will be key to handling any emergency prevention.
segments.zh: 解决这些问题将是做好任何应急预防的关键。

segments.text: First we look at spills and dripping.
segments.zh: 首先我们看洒漏和滴漏。

segments.text: Even something as harmless-seeming as a water spill can result in slipping hazards and electrical
segments.zh: 即使是看似无害的洒水，也可能导致滑倒危险和电气

segments.text: problems.
segments.zh: 问题。

segments.text: And water can also react with chemicals, like lye, in ways that can produce chemical burns.
segments.zh: 而且水还会与碱液之类的化学品发生反应，造成化学灼伤。

segments.text: Then there are common chemical hazards.
segments.zh: 然后是常见的化学危害。

segments.text: These include solvents, adhesives, paints, and even breathing toxic dust.
segments.zh: 这包括溶剂、黏合剂、油漆，甚至吸入有毒粉尘。

segments.text: Some of these can pose lower grade but still dangerous risk if they're not addressed.
segments.zh: 其中一些如果不加以处理，可能会带来程度较低但仍然危险的风险。

segments.text: What about physical hazards?
segments.zh: 那物理危害呢？

segments.text: Think about any relevant noise or heat warnings that can cause physical harm to any potential
segments.zh: 想一想任何相关的噪声或高温警告，这些都可能对任何可能接触的

segments.text: employees.
segments.zh: 员工造成身体伤害。

segments.text: How about unplanned equipment shutdowns?
segments.zh: 那计划外的设备停机呢？

segments.text: If a key piece of equipment shuts down in the middle of an operation, does it leak?
segments.zh: 如果一台关键设备在操作过程中停机，它会泄漏吗？

segments.text: Does it create a new threat or risk?
segments.zh: 它会造成新的威胁或风险吗？

segments.text: You're going to need to address any unplanned equipment shutdown.
segments.zh: 你需要应对任何计划外的设备停机。

segments.text: Finally we look at weather risks.
segments.zh: 最后我们看天气风险。

segments.text: Even if you do everything you can to ensure proper storage of your hazardous materials,
segments.zh: 即使你尽一切努力确保危险材料妥善储存，

segments.text: there's always the risk that weather damage can change the environment.
segments.zh: 天气造成的损坏也总有可能改变环境。

segments.text: OSHA recommends you to have a hazard control plan for each of these potential issues down
segments.zh: OSHA 建议你针对这些潜在问题中的每一项，都制定一份书面的

segments.text: on paper.
segments.zh: 危害控制计划。

segments.text: Combined with your improved communication for hazardous materials, your proactive training,
segments.zh: 再加上改进的危险材料沟通、积极主动的培训，

segments.text: and enforcing good storage requirements, you'll have a much better plan in place for ensuring
segments.zh: 以及严格执行良好的储存要求，你就能制定一个好得多的计划，确保

segments.text: good material safety moving forward.
segments.zh: 今后的材料安全。
